slotDescriptions.messageList: The component that renders the message list.
slotDescriptions.messageListContent: The component that renders the message list content.
slotDescriptions.messageListOverlay: The component that renders the message list overlay.
slotDescriptions.messageListScrollbar: The component that renders the message list scrollbar.
slotDescriptions.messageListScrollbarThumb: The component that renders the message list scrollbar thumb.
slotDescriptions.messageListScroller: The component that renders the message list scroller.
slotDescriptions.messageListStatus: The visually-hidden role="status" element announcing streaming transitions ("Assistant is responding" / "Response complete") to screen readers. Pass null-rendering component to silence the announcements.
